sql: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(q),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id,owner,owner_id,version,metadata->>'size' AS size,metadata->>'mimetype' AS mime,metadata->>'eTag' AS etag FROM storage.objects WHERE bucket_id='operation-evidence' AND name='ba40a958-0747-4751-9b33-b3326bf7b802/56287049-790d-4288-a26a-3d304c7d240e/required-mismatch.png') q;
